Out of 15 genes, 6 (40%) were significantly differentially regulated (P<0.05/15) in either glomerular or tubulointerstitial compartment and four of them (CD14, CXADR, MMP7, WFDC2) in both compartments.

In addition to significant MR evidence for UMOD, nominally significant (P<0.05) and directionally consistent evidence was observed for five of the 59 replicated proteins, including CD300A, ATRAID and INHBB for progression to KF and CD300A, CD55 and UMOD for rapid kidney function decline.
